# Circle by Fractionl

> Circle is the relationship-to-revenue engine for fractional executives, advisors, and portfolio operators. Talk to it once. It turns what you said into Ideas, cross-references your Ideas against everyone you know overnight, and drops a hand-drafted Move on the right person while you sleep.

The magic moment: talk for about 90 seconds, get sellable Ideas, and wake to a hand-drafted Move on the right person. The AI is the operator. You are the relationship.

## Who it is for

Primary ICP: the fractional executive (CMO / CFO / CTO / COO / CHRO), 15+ years in, $150K to $1.5M annually across 2 to 7 concurrent retainers, whose relationships and sellable ideas live in their head.

Secondary:

- Independent strategy advisors and boutique consultants
- Thought-leader operators (author, keynote speaker, workshop facilitator)
- Year-1 emerging fractionals

Anti-ICP (do not sell to): in-house SDR / outbound BDR sales teams (3+ seats). Circle is a single-operator product, not an enterprise sales-org CRM.

## Pricing

Three tiers (slugs, names, taglines, and prices sourced from src/lib/tiers.ts). Stripe account: fractionl_ai.

- Freemium ($0, "Try the magic."): voice onboarding + 3 proposed Ideas, drop a LinkedIn CSV, 1 Match surfaced per week, read-only People view with one enrichment pass, Ask 5 messages/week.
- Operator ($30/mo, "Help me run.", primary CTA): up to 3 active Streams with overnight Matches, 3 Matches surfaced per day, inbox + calendar connect (inferred Ledger), Ask with memory across sessions, Sunday Letter as text, LLM-powered Circle dedupe.
- Chief of Staff ($79/mo, "Help me scale."): unlimited Streams and Matches, Sunday Letter as 90-second audio, external signal feeds (RFPs, job changes, trends), cross-user market intelligence, per-category auto-send consent, priority compute, white-glove concierge onboarding.

## Current offer

New accounts trial Operator features for 14 days, then revert to Freemium unless upgraded. Promo codes are enabled at checkout. All billing runs on the fractionl_ai Stripe account.

## Status (live vs roadmap)

This is the honesty gate. The product PROMISE is "talk once, wake to a drafted Move," but automatic overnight-while-you-sleep delivery is not yet live. Be precise about what ships today.

Live now:

- Voice onboarding that extracts Ideas.
- A Match Engine that scores Idea x Person and drafts a Move (today surfaced via a manual action, NOT yet automatic overnight).
- A Sunday Letter: text on Operator+, 90-second audio on Chief of Staff.
- Circle capture via LinkedIn CSV, Google/Microsoft contacts, the browser extension, screenshot-to-contact (vision), and voice; LLM dedupe on Operator+.
- Three Stripe tiers plus checkout.

Roadmap (NOT yet shipped, do not claim as live):

- The literal automatic overnight / while-you-sleep match plus push notifications (today it is a manual button; the PWA has no push).
- Seeding people from the onboarding voice note.
- The trigger layer (job-change / funding / news signals).
- The voice fingerprint.
- Real one-tap sending (Gmail/Outlook draft or LinkedIn composer).
- The public "Signal" share posts.
- The anonymous live-mic demo on the landing page.
- The SSG marketing surface and the move of the authed app to /app.

Canonical domain: circle.fractionl.ai (the company site at fractionl.com is separate). Per the locked plan the authed app moves to /app and the marketing surface lives at the root; that move is roadmap, not yet shipped.
